instruction: Add Terminal to the favorite applications in the favorites bar

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires adding GNOME Terminal to favorites. Initial apps are ['thunderbird.desktop', 'vim.desktop', 'google-chrome.desktop']. Evaluator checks for all apps including Terminal using check_gnome_favorite_apps.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly executes gsettings command to retrieve GNOME favorite-apps list
Metric check_gnome_favorite_apps correctly parses the string output and compares using set equality
Expected value correctly includes the initial apps (thunderbird, vim, chrome) plus the new Terminal app (org.gnome.Terminal.desktop)
Complete coverage: evaluator verifies both that Terminal was added AND that existing favorites were preserved
Set comparison is appropriate for favorites list (order doesn't matter for favorites bar)
Data flow is correct: command output string -> eval() parse -> set comparison
